_about: Places whose name in a language is another place's name too, and the word their page title adds in brackets to tell them apart («Ефиопия (Нубия)», «Афек (Антипатрида)»), as the English titles add where a namesake is today. The word names no other place on the map; the name itself stays the Bible's. Read by scripts/build-pages.ts, which stops when two pages search engines index still share a title.
